scope: All 467 successful original gate, diagnostic, and continuation responses, including all 454 successful continuation requests. The failed HTTP429 has no reported usage and is excluded from calibration, with its full reservation retained separately.
interpretation: Approximate future rate pacing only; no guarantee about future server token estimates. Financial reservation bounds and immutable outgoing bodies are unchanged.
method: On a counting copy only, omit encrypted_content and add each retained reasoning item originating response entire output-token count; tokenize remaining canonical JSON with o200k_base, then apply 10% headroom. Pacing units use max(output cap, visible tokens plus opaque allowance).
calibration_uses_all_archives_for_lookup: Opaque allowance lookup includes the complete frozen response archive. Every ID is also bound to its ciphertext hash; no ciphertext is decoded.
